disease_metadata.name: Cholera / Acute Gastroenteritis
disease_metadata.advice: 🚨 URGENT: Drink boiled water immediately, use ORS (Oral Rehydration Solution), avoid contaminated food/water, and visit the nearest health center IMMEDIATELY. This is a medical emergency.

disease_metadata.name: Typhoid Fever
disease_metadata.advice: ⚠️ Take complete rest, avoid street food and untreated water, maintain hygiene, and visit a clinic for proper diagnosis and antibiotics. Monitor temperature regularly.

disease_metadata.name: Hepatitis A
disease_metadata.advice: 🚨 URGENT: Avoid contaminated food and water, maintain strict hygiene, rest completely, and see a doctor immediately. Hepatitis A is highly contagious - isolate patient and disinfect surfaces.

disease_metadata.name: Bacterial Dysentery
disease_metadata.advice: 🚨 Take ORS immediately, maintain hygiene, avoid solid foods initially, and consult a doctor. Blood in stool requires immediate medical attention.

disease_metadata.name: Water-related Skin Infection
disease_metadata.advice: ℹ️ Maintain personal hygiene, avoid contact with dirty water, keep affected area clean and dry, and apply antiseptic. Visit health worker if rash spreads or worsens.

disease_metadata.name: Malaria / General Infection
disease_metadata.advice: ⚠️ Sleep under mosquito nets, take prescribed antimalarial medication, drink plenty of fluids, and seek medical help. Monitor fever patterns (intermittent fever is typical of malaria).

disease_metadata.name: Acute Diarrheal Disease
disease_metadata.advice: ⚠️ Drink ORS frequently, eat bland foods (rice, banana), maintain hygiene, boil all drinking water, and visit health center if symptoms persist for more than 2 days.

disease_metadata.name: Gastroenteritis
disease_metadata.advice: ⚠️ Stay hydrated with ORS, avoid dairy and spicy foods, rest, and maintain hand hygiene. Visit doctor if symptoms worsen or persist beyond 3 days.
